method: Native battle probes: four three-member archetypes, three authored boss checkpoints, three paired seeds, tiers 0-5. Fresh profile keeps IV15 at every tier; captured profile uses the tier wild mean in all stats as a representative approximation, not a random sample or guaranteed catch. Enemy boss sets unchanged. Mirror uses fixed IV31 enemy rosters at all tiers. Balanced preboss support is included for player. Lesser-impact rules selected first. No items/blessings, echo upgrades, PP attrition, resource acquisition or human decisions. Not a full 200-floor clear-rate estimate.
